Volunteer Title: California Statewide Volunteer Service and Service Corps
Description: Join the California Service Corps to give back to your community while building valuable professional skills and tackling the state’s most pressing challenges. Volunteers can participate in a variety of programs including climate action, youth mentoring, and disaster response through initiatives like AmeriCorps and the Youth Service Corps. This opportunity allows individuals to lead with purpose, build stronger local communities, and gain experience in public service.
Passion Areas: Community Building, Climate Action, Youth Services, Disaster Response

Description: Join a dedicated team that provides 24-hour immediate support and assistance to individuals and families who have been impacted by home fires or other local disasters. You will be part of a response team that offers comfort and helps provide for the essential needs of those who have lost their homes. This role is a vital way to provide humanitarian aid directly to your neighbors during their most difficult moments.
Address/Virtual: Southern California (Orange, Riverside, San Diego, Imperial, and San Bernardino Counties)

Description: Join the California Service Corps to give back to your community while building valuable professional skills through programs like AmeriCorps and the Climate Action Corps. Volunteers engage in civic action to tackle California's most pressing challenges, ranging from food distributions to climate action projects. This opportunity allows participants to lead with purpose and help build stronger, more resilient communities across the state.
Passion Areas: Community Building, Climate Action, Youth Services
